question: Does the validation evidence authorize delivering the standalone nemotron-mlx backend, and what is the disposition of the non-Nemotron conflict pairs the branch still carries in pyproject.toml?

artifacts.summary: Validation cycle 2 independently reproduced AC-5 to AC-8 and closed the two gaps implementation left unmeasured (real-time feed, Mandarin boundary). The branch is 12 files against origin/main with no mlx-qwen3 member; lock checks are green on 3.11/3.12/3.13 with a two-package delta and zero version changes; the double-space fix holds end-to-end at immediate and real-time feed (4 to 0) and on Mandarin (8 to 0) with WER and CER unchanged. Open item: pyproject.toml still carries two conflict pairs that are not Nemotron members, inherited from the stacked branch. The reviewer called deletion unsafe and recommended keep-with-comment or split-into-own-commit; that basis does not reproduce. A re-lock from pristine main with only the Nemotron addition leaves the 39-package nvidia set identical, cuda-toolkit 13.0.2 and torch 2.11.0+cu129 unchanged, and zero version differences; the real cost is two extra transitive entries (httpx2-jsfetch, win32-setctime) and miniaudio 1.71 to 1.73. The captain directed that the uv changes stick to the fresh branch, so the recommended request is revise back to implementation for deletion plus a regenerated lock and a corrected disclosure.
